PHYSICS — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic induction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic induction.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic induction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic induction.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

15. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

16. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Dynamics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Circular motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Floating and Sinking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Quantity of Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
